findings.evidence: `discAtlas` is tagged `@[expose, simps n center dom]`, so `discAtlas_dom` and `discAtlas_center` exist but are never used.
findings.fix: After `subst hj`, rewrite with `fiveChartAtlas`, `discAtlas_center`, `discAtlas_dom`, `fiveCentre` and `Fin.cases_succ`, e.g. `simp only [fiveChartAtlas, discAtlas_dom, Fin.cases_succ]`. Better still, add `@[simp]` lemmas `fiveChartAtlas_dom_succ` and `fiveChartAtlas_center_succ`.
findings.issue: `image_fiveChartAtlas_of_ne` uses `change chartAt _ (fiveCentre k) = _ … rfl` and a long `change @Fin.cases 4 (fun _ ↦ Set CentredClosedDisc) … k = _ … rfl`. The comment only says the values are read off by cases, not why `change` is needed. Both rely on definitional equality through `fiveChartAtlas`/`discAtlas`.

findings.evidence: In `FiniteBundleAtlas/Basic.lean:201`, `abbrev chart (i) := chartAt E (A.center i)`. The proofs reach `center` and `dom` only by definitional unfolding, never through the simps lemmas.
findings.fix: Use `discAtlas_dom`, `discAtlas_center` and `Fin.cases_zero` rewrites, plus a `mem_innerDom` iff lemma (and a `mem_halfDiscDom` one), in place of `change`/`show`/`replace`. Where unfolding really is needed, add a one-line comment.
findings.issue: Same defeq pattern elsewhere. (1) `image_fiveChartAtlas_zero_subset`: `change chartAt _ (fiveCentre 0) = _`, plus `replace hz : ‖(z : ℂ)‖ < 1 / 2 := hz`, which unfolds membership in `(fiveChartAtlas F).dom 0` through `Fin.cases` and `innerDom`; neither has a comment. (2) `image_eightChartAtlas`: `show (eightChartAtlas F).dom k = halfDiscDom (circlePt k) 2 from rfl`, and `hc := chartAt_circlePtDisc k`, which relies on `chart k` being defeq to `chartAt _ (circlePtDisc k)`. (3) The cover proof of `fiveChartAtlas`: `show z ∈ innerDom from h0` and `replace hz : ‖(z : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := hz`, without the comment that the matching `replace` in `closure_halfDiscDom_subset` has.

findings.evidence: Lines with `have hpos : 0 < ‖ζ + z‖ := norm_pos_iff.2 fun h0 ↦ hz (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h0)` and the following `rwa [norm_div, norm_mul, norm_I, one_mul, div_lt_iff₀ hpos]` appear in both directions of the iff.
findings.fix: Add a lemma `norm_coe_cayleyChart_apply : ‖(cayleyChart ζ hζ z : ℂ)‖ = ‖ζ - z‖ / ‖ζ + z‖`, proved with `simp [norm_div, norm_mul]`, and a source-positivity lemma. Then rewrite each direction of the `ext` once.
findings.issue: In `cayleyChart_image_setOf_lt`, the identity `‖I (ζ - z)/(ζ + z)‖ = ‖ζ - z‖/‖ζ + z‖` and the positivity step `hpos` are each proved twice by the same chain `rwa [norm_div, norm_mul, norm_I, one_mul, div_lt_iff₀ hpos]`. The module docstring presents this as the key fact, but it is never stated as a lemma.

findings.evidence: Rubric: prefer robust automation over long chains of named-lemma rewriting.
findings.fix: Replace each with something like `simp [hzζ, ← two_mul, hζ] at hz` or `norm_num [hzζ, hζ, ← two_mul] at hz`, letting automation do the arithmetic.
findings.issue: `closure_halfDiscDom_subset` closes with an 8-step named rewrite chain (`rw [hzζ, sub_neg_eq_add, add_neg_cancel, norm_zero, mul_zero, ← two_mul, norm_mul, hζ] at hz; norm_num at hz`), which will break on Mathlib renames. A similar 5-step chain appears in `cayleyChart_image_setOf_lt` (`rw [hz, sub_neg_eq_add, add_neg_cancel, norm_zero, mul_zero] at h`).

summary: The chart-image proofs use `change`, `show … from rfl` and `replace … := h` to unfold `discAtlas`, `Fin.cases` and set membership, with no comment saying why, although `discAtlas` already generates `discAtlas_dom` and `discAtlas_center` via simps. The Cayley-norm computation is repeated as identical rewrite chains instead of being one lemma.
